name: Avians ehf. (formerly Isavia ANS)
notes: Renamed from placeholder is-isavia. isavia.is (redirecting to kefairport.com/isavia) states that Isavia owns subsidiaries handling air navigation: Avians (avians.is) provides air navigation services in the Reykjavik CTA; the avians.is 'About us' page names Avians as the company, while page titles and some texts still say 'Isavia ANS', so Avians is treated as the successor name of Isavia ANS (not confirmed as an explicit rebrand statement). The Avians logo is served only as an inline SVG sprite symbol (icon-svg-logo, logo-vertical) in the page HTML, with no file URL, so no asset is recorded.
